description_en: Modifies a container proactive defense interception rule
description_zh: 修改容器主动防御拦截规则
name: ModifyInterceptionRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the container cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182997.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
容器集群的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182997.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The switch status of the rule. Valid values:

1: enabled
0: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则的开关状态。取值：

1：表示开启
0：表示关闭
parameters.name: rule_switch

parameters.help_en:
The source rule object. The metric description is as follows:

targetId: the ID of the source object. You can invoke the [ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
源规则对象。包含的参数说明如下：

targetId：源对象ID，您可以调用[ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: src_target

parameters.help_en:
The destination object. The metric description is as follows:

targetId: the ID of the destination object. You can invoke the [ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
ports: the list of destination port ranges
parameters.help_zh:
目的对象。包含的参数说明如下：

targetId：目的对象ID，您可以调用[ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~)接口获取该参数。
ports：目标端口范围列表
parameters.name: dst_target

parameters.help_en:
The interception mode. Valid values:
1: Block Mode
2: Alert mode
3: Allow mode
parameters.help_zh:
拦截模式。取值：
1：拦截模式
2：告警模式
3：放行模式
parameters.name: intercept_type

parameters.help_en: The priority of the rule. The priority ranges from 1 to 1000. A smaller number indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则的优先级，优先级为1~1000，数字越小优先级越高
parameters.name: order_index

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
